why_this_revision: The original frozen_at (17:00 UTC) was later than the plan's own commit (16:16:05 UTC) and than the review's observation (16:26:52 UTC); the freeze time is now the observed time of this write.

The original E1 prediction said identical step counts and end-effector trajectories within 1e-3 m per step, while the executable rule and scorer used a two-step tolerance, a 0.01 m progress tolerance and an end-effector deviation that is only reported. One primary rule is now stated and the end-effector quantity is explicitly diagnostic.

The delivered scorer (sha256 663ea45c4f468b17d90e339ca1bdb598b15fdffdcff226f097eae3ac0603c375) read E1 parity with exit 0 for missing progress on both sides, missing against measured zero, equal unknown outcome strings and a raw record truncated to one row (review controls, 16:28:15 UTC; reproduced here under scorer-controls-001/before). Unavailable, invalid or incomplete measurements must not read as parity or as a difference.

The original interpretation implied that E2 selects the nominal convention and mandates immediate re-confirmation of earlier acceptances. Neither convention is inherently the deployment; the corrected interpretation is below.

primary_rule.comparison: E1 (no qualifying difference) when both outcomes are known and equal, the step counts differ by at most two, and the final progress gains differ by less than 0.01 m; E2 (qualifying difference) otherwise. The progress difference is rounded to the nearest nanometre before comparison, so a difference that is 0.01 m up to floating-point representation counts as reaching the threshold.
primary_rule.progress_definition: final cube_height_m minus the first cube_height_m of the compact trace; every row must carry a finite number; zero is a measurement; null is unavailable
primary_rule.step_count_definition: number of compact trace rows, which must equal the number of raw step rows

quantities: maximum end-effector position deviation over common steps, with the first step above 1 mm
maximum joint position deviation over common steps
diagnostics.role: report only; never a decision predicate; an end-effector deviation above 1 mm inside an E1 pair is reported as such and does not change the reading

admission_per_run.note: the shared reader rejects non-finite JSON constants and malformed JSON
a run that did not complete has no terminal measurement; the attempt is retained and counted
only 'completed' and 'failed'; equal unknown strings are not equal measurements; a null outcome is unresolved

admission_per_run.fail: invalid for non-numeric or non-finite values; unresolved for null values
invalid on digest mismatch; unresolved when absent
invalid on any raw/compact disagreement; unresolved when no raw artifact is declared
invalid when the raw step rows do not match the compact trace in count or index; unresolved when absent
unresolved; the primary rule can still be read when only diagnostics are missing, the diagnostics are then reported unavailable

binding_per_pair.fail: invalid when the declared pair is not restored+nominal; unresolved when undeclared

binding_per_pair.check: same_policy_sha256, same_code_git_head, same_code_lock_sha256, same_code_sources_sha256, same_code_sha256, same_dependencies_sha256, frozen_policy

binding_per_pair.note: the raw reset states must be identical after removing controller.initial_joint

the controller_reset reading must name the declared convention, equal the raw reset header's controller.initial_joint, equal the reset qpos (restored) or the frozen Panda init_qpos (nominal) within 1e-9 rad, and carry the frozen nominal and the raw restored positions
manifest mode: more than one completed record for one assignment is a search, not a retry

states.valid: both runs admitted and every binding check passed; the pair is read E1 or E2
states.invalid: a check ran and failed: a contradiction in the record or a metadata mismatch; the pair is not scored and is never evidence for E2
states.unresolved: a check could not run because the material it needs is absent (null measurement, incomplete process, missing raw artifact, undeclared convention); the pair is not scored
states.missing: an assigned run has no record; the assignment stays in the denominator
states.precedence: invalid over missing over unresolved over valid

aggregate.E2: the registered contrast was observed on at least one admitted (valid) pair
aggregate.E1: all three planned pairs are admitted and none shows a qualifying difference under the tolerances; this is not equivalence over Lift or other seeds
aggregate.incomplete: at least one planned pair is not admitted and no admitted pair reads E2; no parity is inferred from absent data
aggregate.allocation_nonconformance: more records than the eight-execution maximum, or a record outside the six assignments, makes the aggregate not_scored while per-pair readings are retained
aggregate.denominator: every planned assignment and every retained attempt, including crashed or partial runs

engine_supplies: process_status, measurement_status, task_outcome, the compact trace and its digests, artifact digests, initial_state_sha256, identity digests, the deployment record with controller_target, the controller_reset reading, the store seal (integrity.json) and its own pair audit (input-match.json)
evaluation_recomputes: artifact digests against the files, raw/compact correspondence row by row, initial_state_sha256 against the raw reset state, candidate_sha256 against the deployment record, the reset-state equality except the target, the initial observation, policy reset and XML equality, the target against the raw header and the frozen restored/nominal definitions, the metric and the diagnostics
engine_supplied_and_independently_consum.engine_audit_role: input-match.json is read for comparison only; agreement is reported, disagreement is reported; validity is decided by the recomputation

probe.conditions: seeds 0, 10 and 11 are spent development conditions; no fresh confirmation seed is reserved or consumed; no new seed
probe.intervention: the declared controller nullspace target only, applied by the same update_initial_joints call in both conventions (execution lane refinement, allocation.json); everything else identical per pair
probe.retry_rule: A technical retry is permitted only for an infrastructure or process failure (process_status other than completed, with the error retained), at most two in total, each recorded before it runs with the attempt it replaces. A valid unfavorable result is never retried. No retry may change the seed, the convention or any setting.
probe.stop_rule: stop after the six planned executions (eight with retries); decide by the written criterion; no additional seeds, no search for a discordant condition, no confirmation run

interpretation.E1: No qualifying difference was detected on these three exposed conditions under the chosen tolerances. It is not equivalence of the two conventions over Lift, other seeds, other tasks or other policies. The convention difference remains real, retained and, for these conditions, without a registered task consequence.
interpretation.E2: The registered contrast was observed on at least one admitted pair: the target convention changed the task outcome, the step count by more than two, or the final progress gain by at least 0.01 m on that condition. It shows sensitivity, not which convention is correct and not an advantage of any workflow.
report_separately: whether any existing confirmation predicate (task completion, progress minimum, step budget) actually crosses under the other convention
whether a repair decision recorded in the development ablation would change; a difference above the tolerances may still leave both repairs acceptable
whether there is any measured comparison with ordinary tools (the baseline's own playback path); none exists for this probe, which changes the target only
interpretation.no_automatic_inference: No product-value inference follows from E1 or E2. The competent baseline receives the same source evidence and the same ordinary comparison.
interpretation.convention_neutrality: Neither 'nominal' nor 'restored' is inherently the correct deployment. E2 does not select nominal and does not mandate re-confirmation.
interpretation.original_acceptances: Acceptances recorded in the development ablation stand within their recorded execution scope (single reset, restored target). They are not reopened by this probe.
interpretation.if_sensitivity_is_observed: Request a convention-specific impact assessment (which retained acceptances and predicates the observed contrast touches) and a separately bounded confirmation plan. The existing 67-execution confirmation cannot be paid from eight runs and is not authorized here.
